title: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2.4 could allow a remote attacker to bypass security restrictions due to improper…
description: IBM Guardium Data Protection version 12.2.4 contains a vulnerability where improper validation of CSRF tokens for GET requests could allow a remote attacker to bypass security restrictions. This flaw relates to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) protection mechanisms not being properly enforced on certain HTTP methods.
